policy: Research only; exact choice-ID semantic corrections. Preserve raw transcripts, profiles, Yes/No/Unsure/holds, ranking, three-Top cap, earnings, routes and live matcher. Withdraw inferred support whose required evidence disappears; report losses honestly. No invented preferences. New six authored diagnostic items use exact structured evidence only; otherwise unknown. Up to four targeted items, first pair then continuation only if interested. New Grok holdout independently authored without rules/catalog/outcomes; no outcome-based acceptance or retuning. Same frozen policy in every split.
